summary: Defines how to run IP and ARP over an ATM network set up as a logical IP subnet. IP addresses are mapped to ATM addresses through a server. It replaces RFC 1577 and RFC 1626.

eli5.summary: It explains how the Internet's address system can run on a different kind of network by keeping a directory that turns one kind of address into the other.

questions: how does ip work over atm
what is a logical ip subnet in atm
